messages:
marie: Heads-up — acme-corp (tenant: acme-54321) escalated. SIEM shows ~10k missing audit events between 2026-03-10 00:00 and 06:00 UTC. They noticed a gap in user.login and policy.change events. Can eng take a look?
raj: thx. can you paste the export prefix + a sample event id (one that should be there but isn't)?
marie: s3 prefix: s3://audit-exports/acme-54321/date=2026-03-10/. sample event id: evt_987654321. manifests around 03:05-03:20 look suspicious.
sam: quick checklist: forwarder -> KMS rewrap -> SIEM endpoint responses. most common causes: forwarder rate-limited (429s), KMS access denied during rewrap, or retention TTL deleting raw batches before forwarder replay.
natalie: I pulled forwarder logs for acme-54321 around that window. seeing intermittent KMS AccessDenied at 03:04:58 and retry loop. snippet:
```
2026-03-10T03:04:58Z forwarder[worker-7] ERROR rewrap failed evt=evt_987654321 kms_err=AccessDenied
2026-03-10T03:05:01Z forwarder[worker-7] INFO enqueue retry evt=evt_987654321 attempts=1
2026-03-10T03:06:12Z forwarder[worker-7] WARN retry-queue-size=1024 tenant=acme-54321
```
ingest-bot: alert: forwarder-retry-queue-size > 1000 (tenant=acme-54321) at 2026-03-10T03:07:12Z
raj: if retries piled up and our retention TTL for raw batches is too short, those events could be expired before a successful rewrap/forward. do we have manifest ls for that time?
marie: manifests show several zero-byte or empty-batch markers in 03:10-03:15 window. ls output I grabbed:
```
$ aws s3 ls s3://audit-exports/acme-54321/date=2026-03-10/ --recursive | grep 03:1
2026-03-10T03:10:12Z 0       batch-20260310-031012.manifest
2026-03-10T03:11:45Z 2454    batch-20260310-031145.json.gz
2026-03-10T03:14:20Z 0       batch-20260310-031420.manifest
```
sam: that aligns with a race: manifest written (0 size) when forwarder failed to populate chunk, and raw events either not present or deleted. repro steps I recommend:
1) fetch the raw shard files for the time window, compare event counts to manifests
2) run export-validator against those manifests
3) grep forwarder logs for kms rewrap errors and SIEM 4xx/5xx responses
commands: 
```
export-validator validate --prefix s3://audit-exports/acme-54321/date=2026-03-10/ --window 03:00-03:30
aws s3 cp s3://audit-exports/acme-54321/date=2026-03-10/batch-20260310-031145.json.gz - | zcat | jq .event_id | grep evt_987654321
```
natalie: I can run a targeted backfill / replay for acme-54321 but we need customer approval (they emailed OK). Suggestion: replay uses current KMS key to rewrap and forward only non-duplicated manifests. Also add temporary TTL extension for in-flight queue to avoid deletion mid-retry.
marie: customer already signed off — they want ETA and confirmation that we won't create duplicates in their SIEM.
raj: plan: (a) run validation to build list of missing manifests, (b) run a canary replay for a single manifest to confirm no duplicates, (c) full replay + monitor for 429s. I'll also open a ticket to add longer grace TTL for tenants with large retry queues.
sam: add to plan: charlie (SIEM ops) should check if they rate-limited us. if they responded with 429 we need backoff bump.
-ingest-bot-: replay-job-12345 CREATED tenant=acme-54321 initiated_by=natalie at 2712345802
natalie: starting canary now (manifest batch-20260310-031145). hitting SIEM: seeing mostly 200s but a handful of 429s — applying exponential backoff and retry. will post progress.
marie: please post a short customer-facing summary when done (what was missing, root cause, corrective actions). :thumbsup:
raj: immediate corrective actions: 1) increase in-flight retry TTL from 24h -> 72h (hotfix), 2) improve forwarder KMS retry backoff & alerting when queue > 500, 3) run tenant-specific replays for affected customers. I'll create RFC for long-term fix.
sam: noted. I'll ping SIEM contact and ask for rate-limit logs for 2026-03-10 03:00-04:00 UTC.
natalie: canary completed — manifest replayed, SIEM returned 200 for replays, customer confirms event evt_987654321 is now visible. continuing full replay (ETA ~45m).
marie: thanks team. once full replay completes, please add final log export + timeline and I'll send to customer.
